code_version: Source SHA-256 hashes identify measured files, which may be uncommitted.

generator.duplicate_policy: Array IDs sampled uniformly with replacement from range(n//2); queries may repeat.
generator.hit_sampling: Sample existing array positions uniformly with replacement.
generator.miss_sampling: Sample negative integers uniformly with replacement from [-n, -1].
generator.mixed_policy: Exactly half hits for q=100; q=1 skipped as infeasible.
generator.empty_hit_rate: null: no queries, so a hit rate is undefined

skipped_cases.reason: One query cannot contain both a hit and a miss.
One query cannot contain both a hit and a miss.

timing.unit: seconds per complete query batch, not per query
timing.warmup: One untimed call plus calibration for each metric/configuration
timing.order: Configurations shuffled with seed 2026; five consecutive repeats per metric
timing.preparation: prepare_*: includes sorting/set creation and revised early checks
timing.query_batch: query_*: fresh preparation outside each repeat, reused read-only within group
timing.total: Independent public-function calls; fresh preparation for every call
timing.aggregation: Metrics measured independently; medians need not add exactly
timing.overhead: Loop/call overhead and previous-result release included; final result alive after timing
timing.short_calls: Grouped up to max_calls; very short calls remain overhead-sensitive
timing.excluded: Data generation/loading/copying, validation, printing, memory tracing, profiling, dashboard

memory.scope: Fresh separate trace around preparation/query; state and output alive at reading
memory.limits: Python traced allocations, not RSS, all native allocations, or auxiliary space alone
